name: Admin Project Change Client Cascade
description: A project changes owner through ONE guided path (the form field stays immutable; a ghost "Cambiar cliente..." entry on the edit modal opens the cascade). The preview names the full impact before anything runs: records that move, incomes an active cuenta blocks (they detach and keep their client - anular y reemitir is the path for a wrong cuenta), draft cuentas that ride along, issued documents nothing may touch, and clientless rows left for the completion tools. The mode - Mover al nuevo cliente | Desvincular del proyecto - is chosen EVERY time (no preselection; confirm stays disabled until picked) and the apply carries the preview hosting/income ids as a staleness token: 409 records_not_found / records_changed reload the preview instead of guessing. Every touched record leaves an audit row.
